widgets_values:
## LTX-2.5 + Kijai Prompt Relay (GGUF, 1-Stage or 2-Stage)

Temporal prompt routing for **1-image multi-event clips** OR **2–4 guiding images** (`START` + optional `MID-A` / `MID-B` / `END`) + optional locked custom dialog audio.

### Required custom nodes
- [`ComfyUI-GGUF`](https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF) (`UnetLoaderGGUF`)
- [`ComfyUI-PromptRelay`](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-PromptRelay) (`PromptRelaySmartEncode`):
  ```bash
  cd ComfyUI/custom_nodes
  git clone https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-PromptRelay
  ```

### How Prompt Relay works here
- **Stage 1 (8 steps):** Uses `PromptRelaySmartEncode` patched model so each scene's prompt only drives its own time window (prevents later events from bleeding into early frames; works on both video `attn2` and audio `audio_attn2`).
- **Stage 2 (optional, `RUN STAGE 2?` toggle):** Uses the unpatched base model for 3 spatial ×2 refinement steps (avoids resolution/mask mismatch while keeping Stage 1's exact event timing).

### Smart Prompt Syntax (paste straight from LM Studio!)
**Option A — Block headers (equal or weighted):**
```text
Scene 1:
First action...
Scene 2:
Second action...
Scene 3:
Third action...
```
*(Or proportional ranges: `Scene 1-2:`, `Scene 2-5:`, `Scene 5-6:`)*

**Option B — Inline pipes:**
```text
First action [0-50] | Second action [50-150] | Third action [150-200]
```
Leave `global_prompt` filled for persistent character/style details (or leave blank to auto-use Scene 1 as the global anchor).

### 1 Image vs. 2–4 Images
- **1 Start Image (default):** `START` is ON; `END`, `MID-A`, `MID-B` are bypassed so Prompt Relay runs exact integer-frame masking.
- **2 or 3 Images (Start + Mid + End):** Load your images, set `MID-A frame index` (e.g. `96` for 8 s), and select **both** Stage 1 & Stage 2 guide nodes → press **Ctrl+B** to enable.

## Spatial upscaler

Put `ltx-2.5-latent-spatial-upscaler-x2-bf16-1.0.safetensors` in `ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/`, refresh ComfyUI, and select it above.

[Official LTX-2.5 weights](https://huggingface.co/Lightricks/LTX-2.5) (accept the license for access).

ComfyUI may validate this loader even with Stage 2 OFF, so keep the file installed and selected for either mode.

nodes.title: HOW TO: Prompt Relay Tuning, Length & Resolution
widgets_values:
## QUICK TIPS: Prompt Relay + Length + Resolution

- **Duration (`Duration in seconds`):** `5 s` = 121 frames, `8 s` = 193 frames (default), `10 s` = 241 frames @ 24 fps (`8n + 1`).
- **Resolution:** `RUN STAGE 2? = ON` → final size is **2× Stage 1** (e.g. `768×448` → `1536×896`, `960×544` → `1920×1088`). `OFF` → exact Stage 1 size (`768×448` / `768×768`).
- **Transition softness (`epsilon`):** `0.001` = sharp clean segment boundaries (default). Raise to `0.3–0.6` for softer/gradual crossfades between scenes.
- **Do NOT stack with LTX Director** — use either this workflow or `LTXDirector`, not both together.
- **SageAttention note:** Prompt Relay automatically uses PyTorch SDPA on masked cross-attention (self-attention still uses SageAttention).
